names: Ammonium carbonates (i) Ammonium carbonate (ii) Ammonium bicarbonate (Ammonium hydrogen carbonate)

more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Ammonium carbonates is used as a raising agent in food. Its technological role is to release gas that increases the volume of dough.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include edible caseinates, milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
